author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: Proud to be part of the team building the Pensando AI NIC — and by extension, part of AMD's broader AI networking story. As AI workloads scale from pilot to production, purpose-built, programmable networking becomes a key enabler of performance and efficiency. Great read from AMD on what makes AI networking different. #AMD #AINetworking #Pensando #AIInfrastructure #AMDBrandAmbassador
